item.tib: bar do gnad kyi ti ka sogs
item.coloph: zhing khams ngo sprod kyi sgron me/ bar do gcig chod kyi man ngag yang dag don gsal sgron me drug kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa/ srid pa'i rgyal mo'i snying khrag gshen sgom nyams kyi drod tshad/ brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag len 'di/ bla ma rin po che nas rim gyis brgyud do//
